intro: Our Bali Yoga School in Uluwatu offers the opportunity to become a Yoga Alliance certified yoga teacher while surrounded by the natural beauty and peaceful energy of Bali. The campus is located in a serene corner of Uluwatu, less than 15 minutes to some of the most beautiful beaches and sunset cliffs of Bali.

During your break in your training, you can easily go to the heart of Uluwatu or find a short ride to the beach. The place is near everything, but not too near to the tourist crowds to actually concentrate on your practice and studies.
We’re very close to GWK Cultural Park, with a massive running track and beautiful gardens. It is ideal to jog, or even explore when you need a change of scenery other than the beach.

Uluwatu has grown into a mix of modern fusions and traditional Balinese culture. Cafes with coffee and health oriented dishes, restaurants with local and international food and shops where you can buy whatever you need will be found.
